related_audit: A6 related-gold audit (2026-08-09): Sonnet CodeKG trial (runs/claude-sonnet-1/tasks/04.../codekg) reported callee iter_params_for_processing instead of either gold-accepted edge. Verified via events.jsonl that find_callers/find_callees returned BOTH gold-accepted edges (Command.make_context caller, Command.make_parser callee) in that same trial -- the edge was present in the graph and in accepted_suffixes; the model chose to report a third, real, non-gold callee instead. Not a graph coverage or accepted_suffixes defect. The underlying scoring gap is structural: `related` accepts only one volunteered edge (grade_answer requires len(related) == 1, matching the prompt's 'zero or one' instruction -- confirmed intended, not a silent bug), while the real call graph has more than two valid caller/callee edges for this symbol.
